topic: Private location reports healthy but tests to internal app time out
environment: Private location worker in its own subnet/VLAN
symptom_pattern: The private location shows as up in Datadog but tests to an internal application time out or fail DNS. Tests to public sites from the same location pass.
root_cause: The worker runs in a network segment with no route (or no DNS view) to the application network, so egress to Datadog works while internal targets are unreachable.
resolution_path: Distinguish worker health (talks to Datadog) from target reachability
Test reachability from the worker's network/container
Place the worker where it can reach the targets or open the route
info_needed: results from public vs internal tests
a connectivity test from the worker container

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you run curl to the target from inside the worker container?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: It hangs and then times out.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Which network is the worker attached to?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Our DMZ network; the app is on the internal one.
